lines.text: 若要一切如故，就必须让一切改变。
lines.en: If we want things to stay as they are, everything will have to change.
lines.note: 通行金句意译：维斯康蒂《豹》据兰佩杜萨原著名句「Se vogliamo che tutto rimanga com'è, bisogna che tutto cambi」之中译策展版；非逐场对白核对。

lines.text: 我们是豹，是狮。取代我们的将是豺狼与绵羊——而我们这些豹、豺、绵羊，还会照样自以为是社会中坚。
lines.en: We were the leopards, the lions. Those who take our place will be jackals and sheep. And the whole lot of us — leopards, jackals and sheep — will keep thinking ourselves the salt of the earth.
lines.note: 亲王关于变革的著名独白；IMDb/Wikiquote 可查。
